name: claude-code-macos
description: The claude-code-macos plugin: GNU tools and bash 5 for Claude Code's Bash tool on a Mac.

plugins.name: claude-code-macos
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code's Bash tool GNU sed, date, stat, awk, tar, which and xargs on a Mac, from Homebrew's gnubin directories, and says so when the Bash tool is not bash 5.
